policy: observed and derived claims are recomputed against the data home before publish; failures are dropped, not softened. signal and projected pass on schema unless the data contradicts a figure. context is never validated as a finding.

review.text: Millersville followed their win at Shepherd with another over West Chester on Wednesday, and have conceded four goals in seven matches, as few as any side in the conference has let in. Only Slippery Rock have kept the figure that low, and they have played fewer matches to do it.
Lock Haven are still without a win after six matches, four of them drawn.
Millersville have scored eighteen, more than West Chester and Shippensburg have managed between them, and the two sides at the foot of the chart both lost on Wednesday.
Gannon have not lost since their opening match at home to Lake Erie, winning four and drawing one since, and have conceded eight goals in six matches.
Slippery Rock have conceded four goals in five matches and scored twelve, with seven different players among the scorers.
